about: The buildings, roads and open ground round Kowloon Walled City as they stood in December 1986, within 600 m of the centre of the plan box. src/env.js draws it.
notice: Contains data from the Government of the Hong Kong SAR and the CSDI Portal: the Lands Department 1:1000 survey sheets and Building data, the Buildings Department occupation permits, and the Transport Department Road Network. See data/CONTEXT-NOTICE.md.
frame: plan: x and z as in data/plan.json, with the origin at the centre of the plan box (the scene frame of src/layout.js); y up; base 0 for every building

transform.formula: dE = E - E0, dN = N - N0; x0 = sin(b) dE + cos(b) dN, z0 = cos(b) dE - sin(b) dN; x = cos(th) (x0 - dx) + sin(th) (z0 - dz), z = -sin(th) (x0 - dx) + cos(th) (z0 - dz)

cityFit.note: IoU of the plan outline and the City on 11-NE-11A 1987-05 rose from 0.892 to 0.952; scale kept at 1 (a free scale gives 0.996-1.010)

plate.note: the City plate: the plan box and MARGIN of src/layout.js

rules.dated: CSDI footprint with an OP or a completion date before 1987 (Buildings Department)
rules.undated: CSDI footprint with no date, on the 1984-85 and the 1987 sheets (edge share 0.8 or more on both)
rules.lot: CSDI footprint from 1987 on, under 400 m2 and not a thin strip, on both sheets (edge share 0.9 or more): the 1986 building on the same lot lines
rules.traced: outline traced on the 1987 sheet and checked by eye; not in CSDI now
rules.plate: a building that the City plate partly covers has one record for each part off the plate; plateClipped has its whole 1987 outline (ring), which stands partly on the plate
rules.height: CSDI TopHeight - BaseHeight; else storeys x 2.9 m; else INFERRED by the stated rule

leftOut: Buildings from 1987 on (CSDI OP or completion date 1987 or later): the 1988-89 Tung Tau blocks, Kowloon City Plaza (1993) and the towers after 1998. A small new building (under 400 m2) on the same lot lines as a 1986 one gives that outline ("lot"), with an inferred height.
Kowloon City Municipal Services Building: "CIP May 1987" on 11-NE-11A. Its site is open ground here.
Tung Tau Estate Blocks 1-5, 15, 18, 20 and 21: on the 1984-85 sheets, a building site on the 1987 sheets.
The Kai Tak airport terminal: it reaches beyond 600 m. No airport building is in the data.
Open-sided and temporary structures (CSDI types other than Tower and Podium).

Buildings on the City plate (the plan box and the MARGIN of src/layout.js): the structures of Kowloon Walled City Park now, and the parts of Mei Tung House on the plate. plateClipped in the header has the whole outline of Mei Tung House.
Buildings that reach beyond 600 m from the centre of the plan box.
Outlines that the sheet does not close, outlines under 10 m2, and the regions that the review rejected (parks, slopes, roads, yards).
The courts and light wells of the resettlement blocks are filled.
189 closed regions under 25 m2 in the tenement blocks of Kowloon City: yards, light wells or sheds, which the sheet does not tell apart.

openGround.name: Tung Tau Estate building site
openGround.note: The 1984-85 sheets show Blocks 1-5, 15, 18, 20 and 21 here. The 1987 sheets say "CIP May 1987" (11-NE-11A) and "Construction in progress Sept 1987" (11-NE-6C). Cleared ground in December 1986 is INFERRED. The part on the City plate is left out.
openGround.outline: hand-drawn on the 1987 sheet, to about 3 m

openGround.name: Sai Tau Tsuen ground (cleared)
openGround.note: Sai Tau Tsuen lay to the south and west of the City until 1985 (src/main.js); the 1987 sheet shows its ground open. "CIP June 1986" and "Construction in progress May 1987" on 11-NE-11A 1987-05. The east and south sides follow the fence lines of that sheet. The part on the City plate is left out.
openGround.outline: hand-drawn on the 1987 sheet, to about 3 m

openGround.name: Kowloon City Municipal Services Building site
openGround.note: "CIP May 1987" on 11-NE-11A; the outline is the CSDI footprint of the building that stands there now.
